name: Francisco Gost
tagline: Most LinkedIn advice comes from someone who has grown one account.

hero.support: 7.9 million impressions and more than 13,000 new followers in 2026, across 21 accounts. I pull apart what worked and what died, and send it to you every Tuesday.
hero.disclosure: You will also get The Draft, one letter a week on LinkedIn and copywriting. Leave whenever you like.

company.name: RallyUp
company.body: I'm partner and chief of staff at RallyUp. We build LinkedIn audiences for B2B founders and executives: every post hand-written in their voice, engineered to reach the people who buy from them. In 2026 we've shipped more than 750 posts for leadership teams at PandaDoc, Letter.ai, Anchor Browser and Andel.

about.headline: About
about.supporting: Partner at RallyUp. From Mallorca to London, and one cold message that changed the job.

newsletter.headline: The Draft
newsletter.supporting: A weekly letter on LinkedIn and copywriting. The post that worked, the one that died, and the numbers behind both.

stageQuestion.heading: Want the teardown?
stageQuestion.intro: Ten of the best performing posts from the 21 B2B accounts I run, pulled apart line by line, with the real impressions, saves and follower numbers attached. Plus the ones that died.
stageQuestion.trade: Two questions first, so I know who I am writing for. Thirty seconds.
stageQuestion.label: Which of these sounds most like you right now?

options.label: I do not post, and I do not know where to start
I post sometimes and nothing happens
I get views, but nobody ever messages me
I get messages, but from the wrong people
I write for a company, not for myself
I am here for something else

stageQuestion.situationLabel: And what are you doing it for?
stageQuestion.triedLabel: What have you tried that has not worked?
stageQuestion.triedHint: The more you tell me, the more useful I can be. I read every one of these myself. Optional, but it is the answer that helps most.
stageQuestion.triedPlaceholder: For example: posted twice a week for three months, about 400 views a post, not one inbound message. No idea if it is the topic or the writing.
stageQuestion.doneBody: Thank you, genuinely. That shapes what I write next.
